full_judgment: 4. Mr. Fazlul Karim, learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that hat or bazar being acquirable under section 3 read with section 20 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 compensation assessment roll is required to be prepared but in the instant case no such roll was prepared and the land having been recorded as homestead, pond and path-way the High Court Division was within its province to pass the impugned judgment and order. He further submits that there being no hat or bazar as evident from inquiry report the Government cannot take over possession of the land. So urging Mr. Karim seeks to review the judgment of this Division made in the appeal.
